title: did_multiplegt_stat: Stata & Python
text:
Preface
This book illustrates every option of did_multiplegt_stat — the heterogeneity-robust difference-in-differences estimator for continuously-distributed treatments with stayers — side by side in Stata and Python.

1.8 I.10–I.12 — IV-WAS Bootstrap and Seed

Python


import warnings
warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
import pandas as pd
from did_multiplegt_stat import DIDMultiplegtStat

gazoline = pd.read_stata(
    "https://github.com/chaisemartinPackages/ApplicationData/raw/main/data_gazoline.dta"
)

# I.10 — no seed
m = DIDMultiplegtStat(estimator=["ivwaoss"], order=1, bootstrap=2, asinstata=True)
m.fit(gazoline, Y="lngca", ID="id", Time="year", D="lngpinc", Z="tau"); m.summary()

# I.11 — with seed
m = DIDMultiplegtStat(estimator=["ivwaoss"], order=1, bootstrap=2, seed=1, asinstata=True)
m.fit(gazoline, Y="lngca", ID="id", Time="year", D="lngpinc", Z="tau"); m.summary()

# I.12 — same seed = same result
m = DIDMultiplegtStat(estimator=["ivwaoss"], order=1, bootstrap=2, seed=1, asinstata=True)
m.fit(gazoline, Y="lngca", ID="id", Time="year", D="lngpinc", Z="tau"); m.summary()

title: 3  Wagepan: Exact Match

3.3 IV.03 — IV-WAS with Exact Match
import warnings
warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
import numpy as np
import wooldridge
from did_multiplegt_stat import DIDMultiplegtStat

wagepan = wooldridge.data("wagepan")

rng = np.random.default_rng(12345)
wagepan2 = wagepan.copy()
wagepan2["dis_u"]  = rng.integers(1, 6, size=len(wagepan)) + wagepan["union"]
wagepan2["lwage2"] = wagepan["lwage"] + 3 * wagepan2["dis_u"]

m = DIDMultiplegtStat(estimator=["ivwaoss"], exact_match=True, placebo=1, asinstata=True)
m.fit(wagepan2, Y="lwage2", ID="nr", Time="year", D="dis_u", Z="union")
m.summary()

3.4 IV.04 — Other Treatments
import warnings
warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
import numpy as np
import wooldridge
from did_multiplegt_stat import DIDMultiplegtStat

wagepan = wooldridge.data("wagepan")

wagepan3 = wagepan.copy()
wagepan3["othertreat"]  = (wagepan["lwage"] > 1.5).astype(int)
wagepan3["othertreat2"] = ((wagepan["lwage"] < 1) | (wagepan["lwage"] > 2)).astype(int)

m = DIDMultiplegtStat(estimator=["waoss"], exact_match=True, placebo=1,
                       other_treatments=["othertreat","othertreat2"], asinstata=True)
m.fit(wagepan3, Y="lwage", ID="nr", Time="year", D="union")
m.summary()

5.8 ML.08 — Comparison Table
import warnings
warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
import pandas as pd
from did_multiplegt_stat import DIDMultiplegtStat
from sklearn.ensemble import (RandomForestRegressor, RandomForestClassifier,
                               BaggingRegressor, BaggingClassifier)
from sklearn.neural_network import MLPRegressor, MLPClassifier
from sklearn.tree import DecisionTreeRegressor, DecisionTreeClassifier
from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression, LogisticRegression

SEED = 42
gazoline = pd.read_stata(
    "https://github.com/chaisemartinPackages/ApplicationData/raw/main/data_gazoline.dta"
)
import time

strategies = {
    "Default (sklearn)": {},
    "asinstata":         {"asinstata": True},
    "Random Forest":     {
        "model_deltay": RandomForestRegressor(n_estimators=50, max_depth=5, random_state=SEED),
        "model_stayer": RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=50, max_depth=5, random_state=SEED)},
    "Bagging (trees)":   {
        "model_deltay": BaggingRegressor(estimator=DecisionTreeRegressor(max_depth=4),
                                          n_estimators=50, random_state=SEED),
        "model_stayer": BaggingClassifier(estimator=DecisionTreeClassifier(max_depth=4),
                                           n_estimators=50, random_state=SEED)},
}
for name, kwargs in strategies.items():
    t0 = time.time()
    m = DIDMultiplegtStat(estimator=["waoss"], order=1, controls=["lngpinc"],
                           placebo=1, **kwargs)
    m.fit(gazoline, Y="lngca", ID="id", Time="year", D="tau")
    elapsed = time.time() - t0
    tbl = m.results_["results"]["table"]
    coef = float(tbl.loc["WAS"]["Estimate"])
    se   = float(tbl.loc["WAS"]["SE"])
    print(f"{name:25s}  WAS={coef:+.7f}  SE={se:.7f}  ({elapsed:.1f}s)")
